name: build
description: Run Maven on the project with the given lifecycle phases or plugin goals, for example ["verify"] or ["clean","install"]. Returns compact JSON: outcome, exit code, duration, the Maven command, the session-end event, the first diagnostics and failed tests from the build event stream, whether a failure digest exists (read it with explain_failure), and the paths of the run's files. When no build-events extension ran, or Maven was stopped at the time limit, it says so and returns the first [ERROR] lines of the log instead. Any plugin goal runs with the given properties, so this can run programs and delete files (clean). Values cannot start with '-' and cannot hold white space or shell characters; on Windows, where Maven starts through mvn.cmd, property values also cannot hold '=' or ','.

goals.description: Lifecycle phases or plugin goals, in order.

projects.description: Modules to build (-pl): a relative path or [groupId]:artifactId.

alsoMake.description: Also build the modules the selected ones depend on (-am). Default true.

properties.description: User properties, passed as -Dkey=value. Properties that redirect which configuration Maven reads, where it writes its log or where it connects (maven.repo.*, maven.settings*, maven.user.*, maven.installation.*, settings.*, maven.logFile, maven.logger.*, org.slf4j.*, user.*, java.*, javax.*, http(s).*, proxy*, the server's own maven.agent*/maven.events.*, and others listed in the README) are refused.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop Maven after this many seconds. Default 900.

name: test
description: Run one test selection with Surefire (-Dtest), or with Failsafe (-Dit.test, phase verify) when it is true, optionally in one module and the modules it depends on. A selection is a class, Class#method, Class#a+b, a pattern with *, or a comma-separated list (not on Windows, where Maven starts through mvn.cmd: use a pattern or Class#a+b there). Integration tests run without the unit tests. Returns the same JSON as build plus the selection.

selection.description: Test class, Class#method, Class#a+b, a pattern with * or a comma-separated list (no comma on Windows).

project.description: The module that holds the test; built with -pl <project> -am.

it.description: Run an integration test with Failsafe instead of a unit test.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop Maven after this many seconds. Default 900.

name: effective_pom
description: The effective POM of one module, or of the root project when none is named, written by maven-help-plugin 3.5.1: coordinates, parent, modules, build plugins with their executions (id@phase:goals) and dependencies (groupId:artifactId:version scope), plus the file path and its SHA-256.

project.description: Module path or [groupId]:artifactId; the root project when absent.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop Maven after this many seconds.

name: dependency_tree
description: The resolved dependency tree of one module (run with -pl <project> -am, so reactor modules resolve from the reactor), or of the root project when none is named, written as JSON by maven-dependency-plugin 3.11.0: one row per node in depth-first order with depth d, id groupId:artifactId[:type][:classifier]:version and scope, capped at maxNodes.

project.description: Module path or [groupId]:artifactId; the root project when absent.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop Maven after this many seconds.

name: describe_goal
description: Describe one plugin goal: phase, thread safety, and every configurable parameter with its type, user property, default, whether it is required, and the first sentence of its documentation. Name the goal as prefix:goal (compiler:compile), groupId:artifactId:goal or groupId:artifactId:version:goal. Read from the plugin descriptor in the local repository without running Maven; without a version, the version pinned in the root pom.xml is used, else the highest local release. Falls back to help:describe when the plugin is not in the local repository.

offline.description: Work offline (-o) in the help:describe fallback.

timeoutSeconds.description: Time limit of the help:describe fallback.

name: list_modules
description: The modules of the project, without running Maven: index, groupId:artifactId, path, packaging, version and the reactor modules each one depends on, read from the POMs in declaration order (or from target/agent/project.json when the agent plugin wrote it).

name: explain_failure
description: The failure digest of a build or test run (failure.json, written by the build-events extension): for each failed module the kind, mojo, message, located diagnostics with source lines, failed tests with trimmed stacks, and a command to reproduce. When there is no digest it says why and returns the first [ERROR] lines of the log.

run.description: "latest" (default) or the run number that build or test returned.

name: build_events
description: One page of the build event stream of a run (build-events.jsonl, written by the build-events extension): session-start, project-start, project-end, mojo-start, mojo-end, diagnostic, test, test-suite, repeat and session-end events, filtered by type and project. When the stream is absent it says why.

run.description: "latest" (default) or the run number that build or test returned.

types.description: Event types to keep, for example ["diagnostic","test"].

project.description: Keep events of this module: groupId:artifactId, artifactId or path.
